content.text: FacebookLog InLog InForgot Account?British Telly's PostBritish TellyMarch 16 · Shared with PublicAll six seasons of the acclaimed crime drama Power are leaving Netflix on March 31, 2026. That’s 63 episodes of James “Ghost” St Patrick’s double life as a nightclub owner and New York drug dealer — a race against time for binge-watchers.The series stars Omari Hardwick as Ghost, alongside Curtis '50 Cent' Jackson, Lela Loren, Naturi Naughton, Joseph Sikora, Adam Huss, and Kathrine Narducci.Even though Power ended in 2020, it’s grown into the Power Universe:Power Book II: Ghost (2020–2024)Power Book III: Raising Kanan (2021–2026, final season this year)Power Book IV: Force (3 seasons, wrapped earlier in 2026)Power: Origins (prequel, expected later in 2026)Power: Legacy (sequel, arriving in 2027)Critics have praised the show consistently, with an 81% Fresh rating on Rotten Tomatoes. Season 2 and Season 4 achieved perfect scores, lauded for sharp character development, strong performances, and spot-on music cues.If you’ve been meaning to watch Ghost, Tommy, Angela, and Tasha, now’s the moment — Power streams on Netflix until March 31 only.Do you want me to create a ready-to-post Facebook caption with high engagement hooks for this one?LikeComment LikeComment
